_comment: Sample content so the site is not empty. Replace title/description/tags/link with your real work — this file is the only thing you need to edit. Media is easier to manage from the admin panel at /admin; this list is only a starting point.

projects.description_uz: API Gateway ortidagi mikroservis platformasi: auth, user, billing, media va geocoding servislari. gRPC bilan servislararo aloqa.
projects.description_en: Microservice platform behind an API gateway: auth, user, billing, media and geocoding services, communicating over gRPC.

projects.description_uz: Ushbu saytning backendi. Async SQLAlchemy 2.0, Alembic migratsiyalari, ikki tilli kontent, rate limiting va Telegram bildirishnomalari.
projects.description_en: The backend powering this site: async SQLAlchemy 2.0, Alembic migrations, bilingual content, rate limiting and Telegram notifications.

projects.description_uz: Xarita muharriri uchun backend: geometriya saqlash, versiyalash va gRPC orqali xizmatlararo integratsiya.
projects.description_en: Backend for a map editor: geometry storage, versioning and service-to-service integration over gRPC.
